text.name: Helm of Command
text.description:
{Helm of Command}

All friendly creatures get +5% to their damage and +5% to their damage resitance, and +1 to their speed.
text.event: You have given way to an approaching funeral procession. A column of funeral procession soldiers in polished armor marched past you. Finally, a carriage carrying a coffin with a lady sitting on it came alongside you. She ordered the cart to stop and motioned for you to come. "These things belonged to my husband. He was a brave man and died performing a great deed. His last wish was for me to give his belongings to a traveler like you. Good luck to you, wanderer!"
